Remark
[Euclidean volume upper bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0386 ↗ clm:chow-iii-nonpositive-subharmonic-mean-value-exercise 1. ch26:26.37\group Mean Value Properties

Taking $f=-1$ gives $\Vol B(O,r)\le \omega _nr^n$, the basic Bishop--Gromov comparison.

For the Euclidean heat kernel $H_E$, define the heat ball and its logarithmic weight by \[ E_r(x,t)=\{ (y,s):H_E(x,t;y,s)>r^{-n}\} , \qquad \psi _r=\log (r^nH_E). \]
